pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[clean electric piano solo]
In an abyss no one can ever reach…
Falling drops of sweat echo against the floor
(HEARTBEAT!! HEARTBEAT!!)
[Verse 1]
I've fallen hundreds of times inside the mirror
Even when my claws were worn raw, I got back up again
Left alone on a darkened stage
I never let the word “give up” inside
Even after falling thousands of times, my knees scraped raw
The spark inside me still keeps burning
All I ever had was the dream I held in my heart
[Build-up]
Raise your hand! Higher! My heart will explode!
[Drop]
FINALE! FINALE! (HEY!)
FINALE! FINALE! (HEY!)
[Chorus]
I swallowed every word that said, “You can't do it”
Even when my throat tightened and tears came pouring down, I smiled
I held back burning tears and kept protecting who I am
I bet my whole life on this moment!
(Staked! Staked! Staked! HEY!)
[Piano Solo]
[distorted electric piano solo, melodic and sustained notes]
[Verse 2]
Now all those days
Have become a single light shining down on me
Standing before the final curtain call
I'm not afraid anymore
[Pre-Chorus]
Explode, flame of my soul!
Wings forged by burning through thousands of nights!
Cut through the sky and let your voice resound!
I don't regret burning myself down for this! (HEY!)
[Drop]
Jump up! Fly up!
Swallow the stars! Swallow them all!
FINALE! FINALE! (FINALE!)
[Chorus]
Now rise up, my dream!
Break through the ceiling and swallow the stars!
The lonely echo that once belonged only to me
Is shaking the entire world! (HEY!)
[Bridge]
The moment the final note falls
Silence pours down as a roar
Tears and applause become one
In the place where I hold myself
And tell myself, “You did well”
That's where I am standing…
[Final Drop]
FINALE! Become eternal!
FINALE! Engrave it across the sky!
I don't care if I die!
Rise up and become a star!
(WOO-OO-OO-OOH!)
[Final Chorus]
Now become eternal, this moment!
My name will be engraved across the sky!
I don't care if I die on this stage
This is the greatest finale of my life
In this very moment, I rose up and became a star!
[Outro]
FINALE! (FINALE!) FINALE! (FINALE!)
FINALE! (FINALE!) FINALE! (FINALE!)
At last… I became the star of the finale
And forever…
I will remain by that name…
"Finally, it's done."
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
